arguments.prompt:
Create one native pixel-art game animation SOURCE ATLAS of Leonard. FIXED INCARNATION: Redneck Rampage (1997), original game. APPEARANCE: Lean fictional adult farmhand Leonard with red cap, yellow shirt, blue denim overalls, work boots and a complete battered double-barrel scattergun; original stylised face, no actor likeness.. EQUIPMENT AND ROLE: physically held scattergun. SOURCE ACTION: Tir ajusté du fusil de Leonard. Leonard is the playable brother with a scattergun and rural arsenal. Bubba remains a level-exit objective and Bessie a rescue objective; neither is fabricated as an attacking summon.

Detailed clean16-bit pixel art. Consistent three-quarter side view FACING RIGHT. EXACTLY48 COMPLETE INDEPENDENTLY DRAWN FIGURES, EIGHT COLUMNS and SIX ROWS (8x6). Every consecutive FOUR figures is a four-pose sequence. Every full head, native limbs, wings, tail and complete tool must remain inside its own cell. Draw slightly smaller bodies and GENEROUS TRANSPARENT GUTTERS with a32px outer margin. No overlapping figures, touching silhouettes, labels, text, numbers, grid, scenery, ground, shadows or watermark. Transparent background.

ROW1 columns1-4 INTRO: four different approaching/ready postures. Columns5-8 OUTRO: lower tools/hands, turn, depart, settle.
ROW2 columns1-4 ROUND VICTORY: four brief source-personality acknowledgments. Columns5-8 ROUND LOSS: four different disappointed/breathing/steady postures, completely unharmed.
ROW3 columns1-4 FINISHING PRESENTATION: Leonard visibly grips the complete scattergun: ready, aim, one tiny local muzzle flash only in THIRD pose, recover. No missing muzzle/stock, no victim, alcohol or explosion. Columns5-8 MATCH VICTORY: four distinct celebrations DIFFERENT from the round-win group.
ROW4 columns1-4 MATCH LOSS: four different disappointed/crouched/recovering postures, unharmed. Columns5-8 SUPER: Leonard visibly grips the complete scattergun: ready, aim, one tiny local muzzle flash only in THIRD pose, recover. No missing muzzle/stock, no victim, alcohol or explosion. Four NEW drawings, different from row3.
ROW5 columns1-4 IDLE: four different breathing/weight/wing/ear poses. Columns5-8 RUN: four actual alternating locomotion strides; flying or serpentine movement uses the real anatomy.
ROW6 columns1-4 ORDINARY ACTION: Four distinct postures for the named ordinary source action: Tir du fusil de chasse de Leonard. Prepare, aim or wind up, real source action in THIRD pose, recover. Keep the exact fixed anatomy and tool. No unrelated power or missing equipment. Columns5-8 HIT REACTION: four gentle flinch/steady/recover postures, complete and unharmed.

All48 are genuinely DIFFERENT DRAWINGS, never copied, shifted, mirrored, recoloured or padded duplicates. No attack or flash outside attack groups. No victim, blood, wounds, corpse, dismemberment or injury. Friendly solo game animation. These are original adapted drawings, not official game sprite frames.
